scripts.text:
[Rondo]
Mora is such a mysterious place.
You can understand any language.
scripts.translation:
[回旋曲]
穆拉真是个神秘的地方。
在这里你能听懂任何语言。

scripts.text:
[Rondo]
Of course, when we leave this area I won't be able to understand what you say, but I'll be able to remember the conversations we had. And I'll look forward to the day we meet again, here.
scripts.translation:
[回旋曲]
当然，当我们离开这个区域后，我就听不懂您说的话了，但我能记得我们之间的对话。我很期待再次在这里与您相见的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Rondo]
Please tell Kusmi
that if he wants to meet, we can meet any time. There is nothing to worry about.
scripts.translation:
[回旋曲]
请告诉库斯米，
如果他想见面，我们随时都可以。没什么好担心的。

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
Boo!!!
He broke his promise again!!!
scripts.translation:
[莉莉缇娅]
吓死我了！！！
他又食言了！！！

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
He said he'd be here this time for sure!!!
That place is too cold for me to visit!!!!!
My precious leaves will wither there.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉缇娅]
他说这次一定会来的！！！
那个地方太冷了，我不想去！！！！
我珍贵的叶子在那里会枯萎的。

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
What? Theodore sent you?
Please tell him that I'm so mad!!
scripts.translation:
[莉莉缇娅]
什么？是西奥多派你来的？
请告诉他，我气死了！！

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
I really hate the cold.
That's why Mora is a lovely place to live.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉缇娅]
我真的讨厌寒冷。
所以穆拉是个可爱的居住地。

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
The leaves are always fresh here. And, the stress about languages just disappears.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉缇娅]
这里的叶子总是新鲜的。而且，关于语言的烦恼也消失了。

scripts.text:
[Humming]
Oh!
You're here because Pauchon sent you?
scripts.translation:
[哼唱声]
哦！
你是波雄派你来的？

scripts.text:
[Humming]
It must've been hard for you to get here. I'm impressed.
The Maze of the Hazy Forest~ It fuels my adventurous spirit!
scripts.translation:
[哼唱声]
来到这里一定很不容易吧。我很佩服。
迷雾森林迷宫~ 它激发了我的冒险精神！

scripts.text:
[Humming]
If you reach Splendide before me, please tell Pauchon
that I'm going through the Maze of the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[哼唱声]
如果你比我先到辉煌领域，请告诉波雄，
我正在穿过迷雾森林迷宫。

scripts.text:
[Humming]
I heard that a crevice crept in between Jotunheim and Midgard, so I wanted to check it out. But I got stuck here.
I was looking forward to seeing a new place.
scripts.translation:
[哼唱声]
我听说约顿海姆和米德加尔特之间出现了一道裂缝，所以我想去看看。但我被困在这里了。
我一直很期待能看看新的地方。

scripts.text:
[Humming]
Are you from Midgard?
What is it like there?
I've always wanted to see a creature called Poring.
scripts.translation:
[哼唱声]
你是来自米德加尔特的吗？
那里是什么样的？
我一直很想看看一种叫波利的生物。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Oh.... Darn.......
I can't go down, and I can't go back. My credibility that I've worked so hard on is just crumbling into dust.
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
噢……该死……
我下不去，也回不去。我辛苦建立起来的信誉，就这样化为乌有了。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Ah, are you the traveler who came through the Maze of the Hazy Forest from Splendide?
If you plan to go back, can you please deliver this to the Splendide army?
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
啊，你是那位从辉煌领域穿过迷雾森林迷宫过来的旅行者吗？
如果你打算回去，能麻烦你把这个交给辉煌领域的军队吗？

scripts.text:
[Jones]
A person high up requested it, but I can't cross Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
是上级要求送的，但我过不了双层牛肉堡。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Deliveries to other places have all stopped also. Ah, my credibility is suffering....
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
发往其他地方的快递也都停了。唉，我的信誉受损了……

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
I'm a bit embarrassed to ask this of a stranger...... Ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
向陌生人提出这种要求，我有点不好意思……哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Jones]
You have too many kinds of items. Please lighten your load and come back.
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
你携带的物品种类太多了。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
You are carrying too much weight. Please lighten your load and come back.
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
你携带的重量太重了。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Please take good care of it.
It's for Daphrer in Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
请妥善保管。
这是给辉煌领域的达弗雷尔的。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Please take good care of it.
It's for Daphrer in Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
请妥善保管。
这是给辉煌领域的达弗雷尔的。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Thanks to you, the job is well done.
Hehe, I see potential in you as a delivery man.
Interested in the career of delivery?
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
多亏了你，任务顺利完成。
嘿嘿，我觉得你很有做送货员的潜力。
对送货员这个职业感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Hehe, I see potential in you as a delivery man.
Interested in the career of delivery?
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
嘿嘿，我觉得你很有做送货员的潜力。
对送货员这个职业感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
DRHSfhsdfGSDH FGkkmvoifk DFG DFHshfeksmn fgg FDbbd fjnnvk n skncki dfgd F FHdfkdfjkmv
scripts.translation:
[达弗雷尔]
DRHSfhsdfGSDH FGkkmvoifk DFG DFHshfeksmn fgg FDbbd fjnnvk n skncki dfgd F FHdfkdfjkmv

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
Oh....
I've been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[达弗雷尔]
噢……
我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
This was urgently needed so thank you for bringing it here, I hope I haven't caused you too much trouble..
scripts.translation:
[达弗雷尔]
这东西很急用，谢谢你带过来。希望没有给你添太多麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
This is probably too small to be a reward, but please accept this as a sign of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[达弗雷尔]
这作为奖励可能太微薄了，但请收下，以表我的谢意。

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
Oh....
So you lost the item on the way.
scripts.translation:
[达弗雷尔]
噢……
看来你在路上把东西弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
I knew that it was probably a stretch......
Perhaps I've been unrealistic.
But I thank you for your trouble anyway. Please accept this as a sign of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[达弗雷尔]
我就知道这要求可能有点过分……
也许是我太不切实际了。
但还是要谢谢你的辛苦。请收下这个，以表我的谢意。

scripts.text:
[Daphrer]
For me, a drop of water to make a flower blossom is more important than a sword for war.
scripts.translation:
[达弗雷尔]
对我来说，让花儿绽放的一滴水，比战争用的剑更重要。

scripts.text: Set0
scripts.translation: Set0

scripts.text: Set33
scripts.translation: Set33

scripts.text: Set2_0
scripts.translation: Set2_0

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Oh, wait!
There's another thing I'd like you to do.
There's not enough time to go into details...
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
噢，等等！
还有件事想拜托你。
没时间细说了...

scripts.text: - Cheshire glanced at the guard standing close to you, and leaned close and whispered into your ear.-
scripts.translation: - 柴郡瞥了一眼站在你身边的卫兵，凑近你的耳边低声说道。-

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You'll find cat caravans in the middle of ^4d4dffKamidal Tunnel^000000.
There is ^4d4dffa marked box among the caravans' goods to the west of the entrance to the Scaraba Hole^000000.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
在^4d4dff卡米达尔隧道^000000的中部，你会看到猫的商队。
在^4d4dff斯卡勒伯熔岩^000000入口西侧的商队货物中，有一个标记过的箱子。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
I'd like you to bring it to me.
You'll see where you should bring it by looking at the box.
This is an important matter.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
请把它带给我。
看箱子上的标记，你就知道该送到哪里了。
这件事很重要。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
I have something to get done in advance...
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
我还有些事要提前处理...
祝你好运！

scripts.text: - You have too many items to do this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏太满了，无法执行此任务。 -

scripts.text:
Boxes with all kinds of goods in them are stacked to the ceiling.
The marked box Cheshire was talking about doesn't seem to be here yet.
scripts.translation:
堆满了各种货物的箱子一直堆到了天花板。
柴郡提到的那个标记过的箱子似乎还不在这里。

scripts.text:
Boxes with all kinds of goods in them are stacked to the ceiling.
Looking closely, you find a box with a small piece of paper stuck to it.
You've found the box of goods Cheshire was talking about.
scripts.translation:
堆满了各种货物的箱子一直堆到了天花板。
仔细查看后，你发现了一个贴着纸条的箱子。
你找到了柴郡提到的那个货物箱。

scripts.text: Move the box.
scripts.translation: 移动箱子

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text: You promised to take the box of Bradium to Cheshire, who will be waiting for you near the Crevice of Bifrost.
scripts.translation: 你答应将装有魔力之石的箱子带给柴郡，他会在双层牛肉堡裂缝附近等你。

scripts.text:
You decided to give up delivering the box.
You left the box as it is.
scripts.translation:
你决定放弃运送这个箱子。
你原封不动地留下了箱子。

scripts.text:
Boxes with all kinds of goods in them are stacked to the ceiling.
Looking closely, you find a box with a small piece of paper stuck to it.
scripts.translation:
堆满了各种货物的箱子一直堆到了天花板。
仔细查看后，你发现了一个贴着纸条的箱子。

scripts.text: The piece of paper is marked with some mysterious symbol, and below it is written ^4d4dffTo: The Crevice of Bifrost^000000 in small letters.
scripts.translation: 纸条上画着一些神秘的符号，下面用小字写着^4d4dff致：双层牛肉堡裂缝^000000。

scripts.text:
This must the box Cheshire was talking about.
You decide to take it to the location shown on the piece of paper.
scripts.translation:
这一定是柴郡提到的那个箱子。
你决定把它带到纸条上显示的地点。

scripts.text:
You've already obtained the box Cheshire was talking about.
Now you only have to take it to the Crevice of Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
你已经拿到了柴郡提到的那个箱子。
现在你只需要把它带到双层牛肉堡裂缝即可。

scripts.text: Boxes with all kinds of goods in them are stacked to the ceiling.
scripts.translation: 堆满了各种货物的箱子一直堆到了天花板。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to do this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏太满了，无法执行此任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Bring me 20 pieces of refined Bradium.
In exchange for the box, which you carelessly and irresponsibly sold to somebody.
Have I made myself clear?!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
给我带来20块精炼魔力之石。
作为交换，是你那个不小心且不负责任地卖给了别人的箱子。
我说明白了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
So you've brought it?
The amount is less than it was, but I guess I can't help it.
Next time, you must bring the box to me intact.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
所以你还是带来了？
数量比原来少了，但我猜也没办法。
下次，你必须把箱子完好无损地带给我。

scripts.text: - Cheshire threw the Bradium into the Crevice. -
scripts.translation: - 柴郡将魔力之石扔进了裂缝里。-

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You made a mistake of losing the box, you have to be content with this.
And starting tomorrow, get the box here intact.
Every day.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你弄丢了箱子，只能接受这个结果了。
从明天开始，把箱子完好无损地带到这里。
每天都是。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You've come at just the right time.
And I see the box is intact!
Well done.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你来得正是时候。
而且箱子完好无损！
干得好。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Well, I'll be counting on you, tomorrow as well.
Get it?
Now, leave this place before the Laphines grow suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
好了，明天也指望你了。
明白吗？
现在，趁拉芬人还没起疑心，赶紧离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
...Hmm? Huh?
It's {0}!
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
...嗯？什么？
是你啊，{0}！
你在这里做什么？

scripts.text: Huh? Cheshire?
scripts.translation: 什么？柴郡？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
What makes you so surprised?
Does it surprise you to see me here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你惊讶什么？
在这里见到我让你很意外吗？

scripts.text: Nothing, it's just the hood...
scripts.translation: 没什么，只是那个兜帽...

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Oh... This. Because it's bothersome.
And here, I don't have to mind others.
Oh, and well met!
I was going to put you to work when you came to Diel.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
哦...这个。因为戴着太麻烦了。
而且在这里，我不必在意别人的看法。
啊，幸会！
你来到迪尔的时候，我本来打算让你干活的。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
.......What? Why are you staring at me like that?
his is all for Ahat's good.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
......什么？你为什么那样盯着我看？
这一切都是为了阿哈特好。

scripts.text: I guess I have no choice.
scripts.translation: 看来我别无选择。

scripts.text: I have a lot of things to do!
scripts.translation: 我有很多事要做！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(He will be suspicious if I refuse to do it... I guess I should play along for now.)
Okay.
I'll do anything for Ahat's pleasure.
So, what do you need me for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(如果我拒绝，他可能会起疑心...我想还是先配合一下吧。)
好吧。
为了阿哈特的愉悦，我什么都愿意做。
那么，你需要我做什么？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Things to do?
What things?
This is one of the things you must do.
Don't forget you're are loyal to Ahat.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
要做的事？
什么事？
这就是你必须做的事之一。
别忘了，你是效忠于阿哈特的。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Great! Now I will tell you what to do.
You know there is an entrance to Scaraba Hole in the middle of Kamidal Tunnel?
You will find cat caravans around there who sell supplies and some simple tools.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
很好！现在我来告诉你该做什么。
你知道卡米达尔隧道中间有一个通往斯卡勒伯熔岩的入口吗？
在那附近，你会看到一些贩卖补给品和简单工具的猫商队。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
There is a marked box among the goods stacked there.
I'd like you to bring the box to me.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
在那堆货物中，有一个标记过的箱子。
我要你把那个箱子带给我。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
It's a simple job of picking up and delivering a box.
Do it ^4d4dff quickly and quietly, without being noticed^000000.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
这只是一个简单的取送箱子的任务。
^4d4dff要快速且安静地完成，别被人发现^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Now, move!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
现在，行动！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Bring the box from Kamidal Tunnel.
Quickly and quietly!
No, get a move on!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
把卡米达尔隧道的箱子带过来。
快速且安静！
不，快动起来！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
........That box!
Oh, yes. It's the right one!
You've done a good job.
This is very important.
Ahat will be pleased.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
......那个箱子！
哦，是的，就是那个！
你做得很好。
这非常重要。
阿哈特会很高兴的。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
The boxes will be at the same place every day.
I'll leave the job to you.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
箱子每天都会出现在同一个地方。
这件事就交给你了。

scripts.text: Why don't you do it yourself?
scripts.translation: 为什么你自己不去做？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
........ Hmm...
It's only you humans that have free access to any place.
Plus, this place is Laphine territory.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
......嗯...
只有你们人类可以自由出入任何地方。
而且，这里是拉芬人的地盘。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
I don't attract their attention much, looking like this,
but what would Saphas think?
To see Ahat's man in a Laphine territory?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
我现在的样子不太引人注意，
但萨法他们会怎么想？
看到阿哈特的人出现在拉芬人的地盘上？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
They will grow suspicious.
But you humans are free from such troubles, so that's why you're the right one for the job.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
他们会起疑心的。
不过你们人类没有这种顾虑，所以你是最合适的人选。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(... I don't buy his story, but he believes I'm on his side, so I guess I should play along.)
What happens to this Bradium, then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（……我不太相信他的说辞，但他认为我站在他那边，所以我姑且配合一下吧。）
那这些魔力之石会怎么处理？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
That thing?
Hand it to me.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
那个？
交给我吧。

scripts.text:
- Cheshire opened the box, checked the Bradium in it, threw them into the Crevice,
and looked back, dusting his hands off, and with a triumphant look on his face. -
scripts.translation:
- 柴郡打开箱子，检查了里面的魔力之石，将它们扔进裂缝，
然后回过头，拍了拍手上的灰尘，脸上带着得意的神情。 -

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
This is what happens.
*laugh* Beyond the Crevice lies a path unknown to you.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
就是这样处理的。
*笑* 裂缝的另一边，是你们未知的道路。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Well, I'll leave the matter to you.
Try to bring the box to me every day.
Okay?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
好了，这件事就交给你了。
试着每天把箱子带给我。
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
In compensation for your efforts, I'll give you an Exploit Certification of Sapha and a little cash.
Now, leave this place before the Laphines grow suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
作为对你辛劳的补偿，我会给你萨法的行动证明和一点现金。
现在，趁拉芬人还没起疑心，赶紧离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Huh? What's up?
You haven't brought the box today?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
咦？怎么了？
你今天没带箱子来？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Hmm, this is unexpected...
Well, I have no choice then.
I'll have another guy do it today.
But you must do it starting tomorrow, okay?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
嗯，这出乎意料……
好吧，我别无选择。
今天我会让另一个人去做。
但从明天开始，你必须做到，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
... Huh? I think I've seen you somewhere...
..........Oh!
{0}...?!
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
……咦？我觉得我在哪里见过你……
..........哦！
{0}...？！
你怎么来这里了？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You say you've forgotten what to do?
You're not supposed to be here.
You're supposed to be at the crevice to the south of Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你说你忘了要做什么？
你不应该在这里。
你应该在迪卡特斯南边的裂缝那里。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Whoa.
What was Ahat thinking when he sent such an idiot to me?
Now, get a move on and do your job.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
天哪。
阿哈特在想什么，竟然派这么个笨蛋来找我？
现在，赶紧动起来，去做你的工作。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
...Why isn't this fellow showing up?
Should be here by now...
Lost the way back perhaps...?
....? Eh? Who, who are you? How long have you been standing here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
……这家伙怎么还没来？
应该早就到了……
也许是迷路了……？
....？咦？你，你是谁？你在这里站了多久了？

scripts.text: A cat?!
scripts.translation: 一只猫？！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Who... who's a cat?!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
谁……谁是猫？！
滚开！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Oh, have you been there?
What happened to the box?
Why are you empty-handed?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
哦，你去了那里？
箱子怎么样了？
为什么你两手空空？

scripts.text: I'll look for it again!
scripts.translation: 我会再去找找看！

scripts.text: I lost it...
scripts.translation: 我弄丢了……

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Make sure you do a good job!
And keep looking for it.
You must not lose it.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
一定要做好工作！
继续寻找它。
绝对不能再弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Where?
Which merchant did you sell it to?
Can't you distinguish between what to sell and what not to sell?
Were you asleep when you made the deal?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
在哪里？
你把它卖给了哪个商人？
你连什么该卖、什么不该卖都分不清吗？
做交易的时候你在睡觉吗？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
This is utterly ridiculous.
Make up for what you lost!
^4d4dff20 pieces of refined Bradium^000000!!!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
这简直太荒唐了。
把你弄丢的东西补回来！
^4d4dff20块精炼魔力之石^000000！！！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Each day, one of these boxes is sent to Kamidal Tunnel.
It's smuggled in among other items.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
每天，都会有一个这样的箱子被送往卡米达尔隧道。
它是混在其他货物里走私进去的。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Sneak into the place on time, and bring the box to me. The boxes will be at the same place every day.
You'll be doing it every day.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
准时潜入那里，把箱子带给我。箱子每天都会出现在同一个地方。
你要每天都这么做。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
It's about time.
Now go get the box.
It should be lying near the entrance to Scaraba Hole in the Kamidal Tunnel.
You've done this before, so you must be familiar with it?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
时间差不多了。
现在去拿箱子。
它应该就在卡米达尔隧道通往斯卡勒伯熔岩的入口附近。
你以前做过，应该很熟悉吧？

scripts.text:
..........?
You sense someone moving around.
There must be someone down there.
scripts.translation:
..........？
你感觉到有人在附近活动。
下面一定有人。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
...Eh?
What a surprise. What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
...咦？
真是意外。你在这里做什么？

scripts.text: And what are YOU doing here?
scripts.translation: 那你在这里做什么？

scripts.text: Those ears...?
scripts.translation: 那对耳朵...？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Out for a walk?
I came out with Ahat, but he went back in to take care of an urgent matter.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
出来散步？
我和阿哈特一起出来的，但他回去处理紧急事务了。

scripts.text: Wha... What a pretty tree.
scripts.translation: 哇...好漂亮的树。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
This tree... it's white, transparent, and shiny.
It's a Sapha's body.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
这棵树...它是白色的，透明且闪闪发光。
这是萨法的身体。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You know Saphas slowly turn to stone throughout their lives.
So when they die, they turn to stony trees.
This forest is... their cemetery, so to speak.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你知道萨法在生命过程中会慢慢变成石头。
所以它们死后，就会变成石化的树。
这片森林...可以说是它们的墓地。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
....... Look closely, and you can make out his arms and legs.
Interesting, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
....... 仔细看，你能分辨出它的手臂和腿。
很有趣，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
... .. ...

[Cheshire]
Oh, this is so annoying.
I'm off!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
噢，真烦人。
我走了！

scripts.text: - Cheshire stormed off... -
scripts.translation: - 柴郡气冲冲地离开了... -

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
What? The ears?
Well, it's no wonder because I'm a beastman.
... Why... Why are you staring me like that?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
什么？耳朵？
毕竟我是兽人，这没什么好奇怪的。
... 为什么... 为什么你那样盯着我看？

scripts.text: Are you responsible for the report?!
scripts.translation: 你是负责报告的吗？！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
What are you talking about?
I don't know such a thing!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你在说什么？
我根本不知道那是什么东西！

scripts.text: - Cheshire ran away... -
scripts.translation: - 柴郡逃跑了... -

scripts.text:
A boy dressed in unusual clothing is standing, with a fierce look in his eyes.
You guess you'd better leave him alone.
scripts.translation:
一个穿着奇装异服的男孩站在那里，眼神凶狠。
你最好别惹他。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
You are very delicate.
It's true that I need help,
but I don't think you can help.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
你真是多愁善感。
我确实需要帮助，
但我觉得你帮不上忙。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I hear you passed through the Hazy Forest.
Did you...
Did you happen to see
Lope, my fiance, there?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
听说你经过了迷雾森林。
你... 
你在那里见过我的未婚夫洛佩吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I did.
scripts.translation: 是的，有。

scripts.text: No, I didn't.
scripts.translation: 不，我没见过。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Are you sure? Where did you see him?
Take me there, quick!
...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
你确定吗？你在哪里见过他？
快带我去！
...

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
What?
You're kidding...?
How could you?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
什么？
你在开玩笑...？
你怎么能这样？

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Please find my Lope.
I came here to the Village of Mora
after asking all around,
but there is nothing more I can do.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
请帮我找到洛佩。
我四处打听后来到了穆拉村，
但我已经无能为力了。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
My heart aches at the thought of Lope...
He will be desperately looking for me...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
一想到洛佩，我的心就痛...
他一定正在拼命找我...

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy!
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙！

scripts.text: I'll help you!
scripts.translation: 我会帮你的！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
How heartless!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
真无情！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I heard that he had gone into the Hazy Forest,
while guiding tourists around the village.
One of the tourists who went with Lope
must still be at the inn.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
听说他带着游客在村里游览时，
走进了迷雾森林。
其中一个和洛佩同行的游客
应该还在旅馆里。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
He wouldn't see me and locked himself in the room.
But he might be willing to see you, because you've been to the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
他不愿见我，把自己锁在房间里。
但既然你去过迷雾森林，他也许会愿意见你。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
The tourist is at the inn,
not in front of me!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
游客在旅馆里，
不在我面前！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
So you've seen Pitt!
I knew he would be willing to see you.
What did he say?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
原来你见过皮特！
我就知道他愿意见你。
他说了什么？

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
...No way....!
That is utter nonsense.
To blame Lope for it!
I found this piece of paper
near the Hazy Forest.
I'm sure it's Lope's.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
...不可能....！
这完全是胡说八道。
竟然把责任推给洛佩！
我在迷雾森林附近发现了这张纸片。
我确信这是洛佩的。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
If you find the rest of ^0000FFLope's Clues^000000,
you'll be able to find out
where he is.
I'm counting on you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
如果你找到剩下的^0000FF洛佩之线索^000000，
就能查出他在哪里。
拜托你了，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
If you come across a ^0000FFLope's Clue^000000, please show it to Pitt.
I hope he will tell the truth soon.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
如果你遇到^0000FF洛佩之线索^000000，请拿给皮特看。
希望他早点说出真相。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I don't understand it.
I'm now suspicious of his motives.
Why is he trying so hard to accuse Lope?
Wait... those clues...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
我不明白。
我现在开始怀疑他的动机了。
他为什么这么拼命地指控洛佩？
等等...那些线索...

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Those seem to be more than simple notes.
Can I have a look at them?
...
These fit together like a puzzle.
... Oh!... This is...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
这些看起来不仅仅是普通的笔记。
能让我看看吗？
...
它们像拼图一样拼合在一起。
...噢！...这是...

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
...We've been wandering around the Forest for days.
...So we're not protecting the tourists,
I got sick from deadly poison, and became a burden to everyone.
How pathetic...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
...我们在普勒斯特森林游荡了好几天。
...我们并没有在保护游客，
我中了致命猛毒，成了大家的累赘。
真没用...

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
No wonder I was kicked out of
the Splendide Expedition.
...But I managed to protect at least one tourist.
He will deliver this letter and the ring to you.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
难怪我被赶出了辉煌领域探险队。
...但我至少保护了一位游客。
他会把这封信和戒指交给你。

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
...I wanted to propose to you
as a proud member of the Expedition.
I'm sorry, Euridi.
See you soon.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
...我想以探险队成员的身份向你求婚。
对不起，尤里迪。
再见。

scripts.text:
Having read the letter,
Euridi is standing staring blankly like someone who wasn't all there.
Let's go show the letter to Pitt.
scripts.translation:
读完信后，
尤里迪呆立在那里，眼神空洞，仿佛魂不守舍。
让我们把信拿给皮特看吧。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
No, Lope must be safe.
He will come back no matter what...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
不，洛佩一定没事。
无论发生什么，他都会回来的...

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
......

You hear a song coming from the girl who is hanging her head low.
Her friend seems to have something to say.
scripts.translation:
你听到那个低着头的女孩正在唱歌。
她的朋友似乎有话要说。

scripts.text:
You hear a quiet singing voice.
You can't make the words out.
scripts.translation:
你听到微弱的歌声。
听不清歌词。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Have you found Lope?
Is he safe?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
你找到洛佩了吗？
他安全吗？

scripts.text: Tell her you can't possibly find him.
scripts.translation: 告诉她你根本找不到他

scripts.text: Tell her he is dead.
scripts.translation: 告诉她他已经死了

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I'll go look for him myself.
Hopefully... it's not too late, yet.
Let me go, there's no time to lose!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
我要亲自去找他。
希望...还来得及。
让我走，没时间浪费了！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I don't believe it.
He told me he would come back soon...
He told me to hang on.
It can't be... It just can't be...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
我不相信。
他说过会很快回来的...
他让我坚持住。
不会的...绝不可能...

scripts.text:
You hand her Lope's Ring, which Pitt gave you.
With the ring in her hand, Euridi bursts into tears.
She starts to sing in a strained voice, still crying.
scripts.translation:
你把皮特给你的洛佩之戒递给她。
尤里迪握着戒指，失声痛哭。
她一边哭，一边用颤抖的声音唱起了歌。

scripts.text:
You stand frozen.
You hear a quiet singing voice.
scripts.translation:
你僵在原地。
你听到微弱的歌声。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Please stop Euridi.
She is desperate to find her missing fiance.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
请阻止尤里迪。
她为了寻找失踪的未婚夫已经走投无路了。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Pitt is definitely suspicious.
I think he is avoiding Euridi...
He must be hiding something.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
皮特绝对很可疑。
我觉得他在躲避尤里迪...
他一定在隐瞒什么。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
To tell the truth, I don't think
that Lope is alive.
I'm just worried about Euridi.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
说实话，我不认为洛佩还活着。
我只是担心尤里迪。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Aaarrrggghhh!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
...
To tell the truth, I really believe
that Lope is alive.
...
*sigh*
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
...
说实话，我真的相信
洛佩还活着。
...
*叹气*

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
How's Pitt doing?
I think I should go visit him
and make him feel worse!
He's so disgusting!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
皮特怎么样了？
我觉得我应该去拜访他，
让他更难受一点！
他真恶心！

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Go to Pitt, quick.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
快去见皮特。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Euridi is singing a song of healing
to protect her weakened body and mind.
At this rate, something's going to happen to her too.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
尤里迪正在唱治愈之歌，
以保护她虚弱的身体和心灵。
照这样下去，她也会出事的。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Oh, I remember a traveler telling me
that he had seen a suspicious man
near the entrance to the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
哦，我记得有个旅行者告诉我，
他在迷雾森林入口附近
看到一个可疑的男子。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
The traveler says he looked creepy standing there staring blankly,
but he couldn't see clearly
because of the thick fog.
I think it's worth investigating.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
旅行者说那人站在那里发呆，看起来很诡异，
但因为雾气太浓，
他看不太清楚。
我觉得值得去调查一下。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
I hear that a suspicious man was seen
near the entrance to the Hazy Forest.
The traveler says he looked creepy standing there staring blankly,
but he couldn't see clearly
because of the thick fog.
I think it's worth investigating.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
听说在迷雾森林入口附近
看到一个可疑的男子。
旅行者说那人站在那里发呆，看起来很诡异，
但因为雾气太浓，
他看不太清楚。
我觉得值得去调查一下。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Your face is dark.
Bad news?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
你脸色很难看。
是坏消息吗？

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
There is a Laphine saying that
desperation invites disaster.
Maybe we're responsible
for what happened.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
拉芬族有句谚语说：
绝望会招致灾难。
也许我们要为
发生的事负责。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
You have too many things with you.
Can you throw out some of them?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
你带的东西太多了。
能扔掉一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Lope will be able to rest in peace now.
Thank you. I won't forget what you've done for me.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
洛佩现在可以安息了。
谢谢你。我不会忘记你为我所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Thank you. I won't forget your help.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
谢谢你。我不会忘记你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So you're quite good,
since you passed through the Hazy Forest alive.
I'm completely messed up, you see,
so I can't afford to listen to the tales of your exploits.
Now leave.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你能活着穿过迷雾森林，
看来你很厉害嘛。
我现在一团糟，
没心情听你吹嘘你的英勇事迹。
现在滚。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
You have a knack for pestering people, don't you?
Euridi sent you, eh?
The Laphine couple is
anxious to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你很擅长纠缠别人，不是吗？
是尤里迪派你来的吧？
那对拉芬族夫妇
想杀了我。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
Go and tell her!
That the stupid guide
pushed us reluctant tourists into the forest,
and ran off to save his own skin!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
去告诉她！
那个愚蠢的向导
把我们这些不情愿的游客推进森林，
然后自己逃命去了！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So you're sorry that it's me, not him, that's here?
He will be alive somewhere,
so go and try to find him! Just stop bothering me!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
所以你是遗憾站在这里的是我，而不是他？
他肯定还活着在某个地方，
所以去试着找他吧！别再来烦我！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
This is all because of
the stupid guide!
I hate Laphines!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
这都是那个
愚蠢的向导的错！
我讨厌拉芬族！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
This is all because of
the stupid guide!
I hate Laphines!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
这都是那个
愚蠢的向导的错！
我讨厌拉芬族！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
That thing you have in your hand...
It looks very strange.
I've never seen such a thing before.
You'd better not keep that.
Can I have it?
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你手里拿的那个东西...
看起来很奇怪。
我从没见过这种东西。
你最好别留着它。
能给我吗？

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 给他

scripts.text: Don't give it to him.
scripts.translation: 不给他

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So I swallow it like this,
and voila! Evidence gone!
Now I can sleep soundly, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我像这样把它吞下去，
看！证据消失了！
这下我可以睡个安稳觉了，谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
Why are you showing me such a thing?
I don't know anything! I'm the victim here!
I'm a victim of the schemes of the Laphine couple.
It's unfair...
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你为什么要给我看这种东西？
我什么都不知道！我才是受害者！
我是那对拉芬族夫妇阴谋的受害者。
这不公平...

scripts.text:
It's no use trying to talk to him any more.
Try talking to Euridi.
scripts.translation:
再跟他说话也没用了。
试着去跟尤里迪谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
This is unfair!
This is so totally unfair!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
这不公平！
这太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
What are you, a professional mover?
Stomping about with a ton of stuff on your back!
I can't rest because of the noise!
Throw away all that stuff!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你是专业的搬运工吗？
背着那么重的东西到处走！
吵得我没法休息！
把那些东西都扔掉！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I never imagined you'd find them all
and piece them together.
Is this a divine punishment...?
Or Laphines' curse?
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我没想到你会把它们都找出来
并拼凑在一起。
这是神的惩罚吗...？
还是拉芬族的诅咒？
呼...

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
That guide fellow,
he opened the gate out
when he was hit hard
by the poison.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
那个向导，
他在被毒液严重击中时，
打开了外面的门。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
When I was hesitating whether to take him with me,
he handed me that letter and the ring.
Laphines' jewelry...
It's rumored that nobody could ever have it except Laphines,
including the Gods themselves.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
当我犹豫要不要带上他时，
他递给我那封信和戒指。
拉芬族的珠宝...
传说除了拉芬族，
连神明都无法拥有它。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So I had in my hands
a treasure among treasures!
How...! Just how on earth
could I have let it pass through!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
所以我手里拿着
珍宝中的珍宝！
天哪...！我到底是怎么
让它从我手中溜走的！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I was going to leave this place
as soon as I pulled myself together.
But now I'm stuck here,
affected by the poison myself.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我本来打算一缓过劲就离开这里。
但现在我被困在这里，
我自己也中了毒。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I'll give you the ring back,
so please leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我把戒指还给你，
求你别再纠缠我了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then where could Lope...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那洛佩会在哪里呢...

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
If he died near the exit of the forest,
he must be somewhere around there,
in whatever form he might be in.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
如果他死在普勒斯特森林的出口附近，
他应该就在那一带，
无论他变成了什么样子。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I'm a victim, too!
So leave me alone! I beg you!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我也是受害者！
所以别管我了！求你了！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
...

He's sleeping.
He seems to be in a very deep sleep.
scripts.translation:
他在睡觉。
他似乎睡得很沉。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......

[Suspicious Man]
Aaaarrrrrggggghhhh!!!!!!
I can't see anything.
Who's there?
Answer, or I'll take you as an enemy and kill you.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！
我什么都看不见。
谁在那里？
回答我，否则我就把你当敌人杀掉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Euridi is looking for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤里迪在找你。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......

[Lope]
Wraith, how can you be so harsh to me?
I asked you to wipe the name off my mind
in return for bearing the curse!
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
恶灵，你怎么能对我这么苛刻？
我让你抹去我脑海中的名字，
作为回报，我承担了诅咒！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Will you please calm down and listen to...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请冷静下来，听我说...

scripts.text:
[Lope]
My desire to help
led me to my death,
And my desire to survive and take revenge
led me to my rebirth.
I will not side with life any more.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
我渴望帮助他人，
却因此走向死亡；
我渴望生存并复仇，
才得以重生。
我不再站在生命这一边了。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
As soon as my transformation is over,
I will punish you all with the bloody confusion of the Hazy Forest,
which saved my life!
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
等我完成变身，
我将用迷雾森林那救过我一命的
血腥混乱来惩罚你们所有人！

scripts.text: You put the letter Euridi pieced together in Lope's hands.
scripts.translation: 你将尤里迪拼凑好的信件递到了洛佩手中。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
...This is!
I feel Euridi's touch.
So the letter... was delivered to Euridi?
This is unbelievable...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
...这是！
我感受到了尤里迪的触碰。
所以这封信...是寄给尤里迪的吗？
这简直难以置信...

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Deformed as I am now,
I'm not her love any more.
Go back, and tell her that Lope turned to dust
on the ground of the Hazy Forest long ago.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
如今我面目全非，
已不再是她所爱的人。
回去吧，告诉她，洛佩早已化作尘土，
消散在迷雾森林的地上了。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Now go!
This is my last request as a Laphine called Lope...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
现在快走吧！
这是我作为拉芬族洛佩最后的请求...

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Deformed as I am now,
I'm not her love any more.
Go back, and tell her that Lope turned to dust
on the ground of the Hazy Forest long ago.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
如今我面目全非，
已不再是她所爱的人。
回去吧，告诉她，洛佩早已化作尘土，
消散在迷雾森林的地上了。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Now go!
This is my last request as a Laphine called Lope...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
现在快走吧！
这是我作为拉芬族洛佩最后的请求...

scripts.text: You see a ring glowing faintly on his left hand.
scripts.translation: 你看到他左手上有一枚微微发光的戒指。

scripts.text: I see a suspicious man. Should I try talking to him?
scripts.translation: 我看到一个可疑的男子。要不要试着和他谈谈？

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 别管他

scripts.text: Talk to him.
scripts.translation: 和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......

[Suspicious Man]
.
...
........!!!

[Suspicious Man]
Aaaaarrrrrggghh!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......

^FF0000- Warning message -
- Hang on there!! -
- You have too many items -
- to receive any more items. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^FF0000- 警告信息 -
- 坚持住！！ -
- 您的物品栏已满 -
- 无法接收更多物品。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 然后重试。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Don't humans sleep?
People should be sleeping at this hour.
Why on earth are you bothering me?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
人类不睡觉的吗？
这个点应该都在睡觉了。
你们到底为什么要来打扰我？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I can't get any sleep because of you.
I have to sleep for my research tomorrow.
You should go sleep too.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
因为你们，我根本睡不着。
我明天还要做研究，必须睡觉。
你们也该去睡觉了。

scripts.text: Z z Z z
scripts.translation: Z z Z z

scripts.text: ^FF0000He appears to be asleep.^000000

[Raffle Researcher]
Oh no~ My research tools...
What...... What was it?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
哎呀~ 我的研究工具...
那...那是什么来着？

scripts.text: What is your business here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Hmm?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're human...? Are you human...?
You... came from the underworld?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你是人类...？你是人类...？
你...是从冥界来的？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Human beings are incredible...
You survived the crevice and made it here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
人类真是不可思议...
你竟然从裂缝中幸存下来，并来到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
... ... ...

[Raffle Researcher]
You, come here for a minute.
It's a simple experiment, so there's no need to be afraid.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你，过来一下。
这只是个简单的实验，不用害怕。

scripts.text: What a crazy Raffle. I must run away.
scripts.translation: 这个拉弗尔太疯狂了。我得赶紧逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You said you had made it up from the Crevice,
so I was wondering what race you were,
but a mere human? How did you get up here?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你说你是从裂缝里爬上来的，
所以我很好奇你是什么种族，
结果只是个普通人类？你是怎么上来的？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
What... I thought a human who made it up from the Crevice
would be extraordinary,
but you're no more than a kid.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
什么... 我以为能从裂缝里爬上来的人类一定很特别，
结果你不过是个小孩。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Go hunt more ^000000Porings^000000
and come back when your level is in the triple digits kid!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
去多打几只^000000波利^000000，
等你等级达到三位数再回来，小孩！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
... ... ...

[Raffle Researcher]
You... You're not like the other humans.
You're not running away...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你... 你和其他人类不一样。
你没有逃跑...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You've got some serious guts...
Now I really want to do some experiments on you...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你胆子真大...
我现在更想在你身上做实验了...

scripts.text: Well... that's... um...

[Raffle Researcher]
Ha ha... Just kidding...
I'm a Raffle researcher,
but I don't research humans.
Actually, I have no idea
what to research
about humans...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
哈哈... 开玩笑的...
我是拉弗尔研究员，
但我并不研究人类。
实际上，我完全不知道
该研究人类什么...

scripts.text: Glad to hear that...
scripts.translation: 听到这个就放心了...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
That's that. You're not busy, are you?
I'd like you to give me a hand...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
那个。你不是很忙吧？
我想请你帮个忙...

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 帮助他。

scripts.text: Help willingly.
scripts.translation: 乐意帮忙。

scripts.text: Although you feel a little embarrassed, help anyhow.
scripts.translation: 虽然有点尴尬，但还是帮忙吧。

scripts.text: Help with conviction.
scripts.translation: 坚定地帮忙。

scripts.text: Help adorably.
scripts.translation: 可爱地帮忙。

scripts.text: You're suspicious, but help anyhow.
scripts.translation: 虽然觉得可疑，但还是帮忙吧。

scripts.text: You have no choice. Help him.
scripts.translation: 别无选择。帮他吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I haven't met many humans
but you clearly care about
another person's hardship.
You must be an ^FF0000extremely^000000 nice human.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我见过的人类不多，
但你明显很关心他人的困境。
你一定是个^FF0000非常^000000善良的人类。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'll save my thanks for time's sake.
It's important, so please take care of it quickly.
I can't proceed with the research because of it.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
为了节省时间，我就不多道谢了。
这件事很重要，请快点处理。
因为这件事，我的研究无法继续了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Here at the Mora Inn,
there's a very famous bath.
If anybody, not just us Raffles,
goes into the bath water
their wounds will be healed instantly...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
在穆拉旅馆里，
有一处非常有名的浴池。
无论是谁，只要不是我们拉弗尔人，
泡进浴池的水里，
伤口就会瞬间愈合...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
So being a great researcher, I went into the bath
to check it out further
and... unfortunately...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
身为一名优秀的研究员，我走进浴池
想进一步调查一下，
结果...不幸的是...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I was attacked by a mysterious creature,
and I lost consciousness.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我被一只神秘的生物袭击了，
然后失去了意识。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
When I woke up, I realized that
my important research tools were missing...
So I was at a loss for what to do.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
等我醒来时，发现
我重要的研究工具不见了...
当时我真是不知所措。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
And here you are, a human,
a brave, heroic human that arrived at Mora Village from the Crevice.
Your willingness to help has really taken this load off of my mind.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
然后你就来了，一个人类，
一个从裂缝来到穆拉村庄的、勇敢而英勇的人类。
你愿意帮忙，真的让我如释重负。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Please go to the bath house and retrieve my research tools.
The sooner you get them back,
the sooner I can get back to my research.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
请去浴池把我的研究工具取回来。
你越快取回它们，
我就能越快恢复研究。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Have a safe trip.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
一路平安。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're back? Where are my research tools?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你回来了？我的研究工具呢？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't found the research tools?
I'm disappointed. Get yourself to the bath
and quickly retrieve my research tools
taken away from me.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你还没找到研究工具？
我很失望。快去浴池，
迅速取回被夺走的我的研究工具。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Wow!! You found the research tools...?
You're quite capable.
I really like how you handle your work.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
哇！！你找到了研究工具...？
你很有能力。
我很喜欢你的办事风格。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I like you.
Do you want to work on my research with me?
I could use your help here and there,
until I'm done with this research.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我喜欢你。
你想和我一起进行这项研究吗？
在我完成这项研究之前，
我会不时需要你的帮助。

scripts.text: As you wish.
scripts.translation: 遵命。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Great. Thanks, and when we're done,
I'll pay you handsomely.
Also, for every research project that's completed,
I'll also give you some pocket money.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
太好了。谢谢，等我们完成后，
我会给你丰厚的报酬。
另外，每完成一个研究项目，
我也会给你一些零花钱。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Young Raffles these days... they are just plain stupid.
I've always wanted a capable research assistant,
but it hasn't been easy to find one.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
现在的年轻拉弗尔人...简直太蠢了。
我一直想要一个有能力的研究助手，
但一直很难找到。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
By the way... Was it that difficult to
reclaim the research tools?
You're carrying some very heavy looking equipment.
Go lighten your load, and I'll pay you for your work.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
顺便问一下...取回研究工具很难吗？
你背着的装备看起来很重。
去减轻一下负担吧，我会支付你工作的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
It must've been hard work to retrieve the tools.
Why don't you take this and go to the inn
and rest up? There's nothing for you to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
取回工具一定很辛苦吧。
拿着这个去旅馆休息一下吧。现在你没什么事可做了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
It must've been hard work to retrieve the tools.
Why don't you take this and go to the inn
and rest up? There's nothing for you to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
取回工具一定很辛苦吧。
拿着这个去旅馆休息一下吧。现在你没什么事可做了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm still preparing for the research.
Unfortunately a few research tools
were damaged.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我还在为研究做准备。
不幸的是，有几件研究工具损坏了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Come to think of it, I don't think
I told you my name.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
说起来，我想我还没告诉你我的名字。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
My name is Inffle. If anybody
asks you who you are working with,
you can say ^0000FFI'm working with Researcher Inffle.^000000
That's why I'm telling you my name.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我的名字是因弗尔。如果有人问你在和谁一起工作，
你可以说^0000FF我在和研究员因弗尔一起工作。^000000
这就是我告诉你我名字的原因。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Why? The inn is closed?
That's strange, it shouldn't be.
Why don't you go try again?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
为什么？旅馆关门了？
这很奇怪，它不应该关门的。
你再去试试好吗？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Darn, I get more worked up the more I think about it.
It's not like I went with bad intentions...
I just wanted to do some research...
Can't believe I got attacked...
I just can't believe it...
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
该死，越想越气。
我并没有带着恶意去...
我只是想做点研究...
居然被袭击了...
真是难以置信...
你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Good thing you're here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
幸好你在这里。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I've been thinking about
the unidentified creature in the bath.
He's quite the little devil, to take research tools,
which are as important to a researcher as his life...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我一直在想那个在浴池里的不明生物。
它真是个小恶魔，竟然拿走了研究工具，
那些工具对研究员来说可是比命还重要...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
A research assistant's job
is to make sure that the researcher can focus on his research
And not have to worry about anything else... VERY! Important.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
研究助手的职责
就是确保研究员能专心研究，
不用为其他事情分心...非常重要！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'd like you to take my revenge
on the unidentified creature for me...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我想让你替我
向那个不明生物复仇...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I don't even want anything that drastic.
3 times! Go bully him for just 3 times.
You can draw on his face,
pinch him, tickle him,
whatever you want. Just bully him 3 times.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我也没想要那么极端。
3次！去欺负它3次就好。
你可以在它脸上画画，
捏它，挠它，
随便你。只要欺负它3次就行。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
How's the work going?
An assistant has to work swiftly and effectively.
Could it be that you have forgotten
what your task is?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
工作进展如何？
助手必须迅速且高效地工作。
难道你忘记
你的任务是什么了吗？

scripts.text: Exactly. What should I do?
scripts.translation: 没错。我该怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Go bully the unidentified creature
just 3 times.
You can draw on his face,
pinch him, tickle him, or whatever.
Bully him 3 times.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
去欺负那个不明生物
3次就好。
你可以在它脸上画画，
捏它，挠它，或者随便什么。
欺负它3次。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
So you taught him a lesson? Great. I feel avenged!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
所以你教训了它？太好了。我解气啦！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
For a while, I couldn't sleep
because I couldn't stop thinking about the lost research tools.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
有一阵子，我因为一直想着丢失的研究工具
而睡不着觉。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
That's that! We need to begin the bath research now.
I need to finish the research quickly,
so that I can start on a new topic.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
好了！我们现在必须开始浴池研究了。
我需要尽快完成研究，
这样我就可以开始新的课题了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Go to the bath water
with the sample tube that I give you,
and gather some samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
拿着我给你的样本管
去浴池的水里，
采集一些样本。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Look around the bath water,
and you will find an area emitting a distinct aura.
You can collect the samples
from that area.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
在浴池的水里四处看看，
你会发现一个散发着独特灵气的区域。
你可以从那个区域
采集样本。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You are carrying too much weight.
I can't give you the sample tube.
Why don't you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你携带的物品太重了。
我无法给你样本管。
你为什么不减轻负重再回来呢？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Here is the sample tube for collecting.
Go and collect 10 samples!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
这是用于采集的样本管。
去采集10个样本！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Have you collected the samples yet?
Please hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你采集样本了吗？
请快点。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Look around the bath water,
and you will find an area emitting a distinct aura.
You can collect the samples
from that area.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
在浴池的水里四处看看，
你会发现一个散发着独特灵气的区域。
你可以从那个区域
采集样本。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I know that you've done a lot...
but you are carrying too many things.
Even though I want to give you pocket money, I can't.
Could you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我知道你做了很多事...
但你携带的东西太多了。
虽然我想给你零花钱，但我给不了。
你能减轻负重再回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You got the bath water sample. Great job.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你拿到了三温暖样本水。干得好。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'll have to run a few tests
with the bath water samples.
It usually takes about 24 hours.
Why don't you come back then?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我要用这些三温暖样本水做几项测试。
通常需要大约24小时。
到时候你再回来吧？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The basic tests have not been completed yet.
There's nothing for you to do now.
Go for a walk.
Spend some money that I gave you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
基础测试还没完成。
现在没什么事让你做。
去散散步吧。
花掉我给你的钱。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The basic tests are done.
As I thought...
There were many interesting substances in the bath water.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
基础测试完成了。
果然不出我所料...
浴池的水里含有许多有趣的物质。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The most notable is this unidentifiable DNA.
I didn't have a chance to compare it to a lot of DNA samples,
but I'm pretty sure that this DNA
has been transformed by the mysterious substances of the bath.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
最引人注目的是这种无法识别的DNA。
虽然我没有机会将它与大量DNA样本进行比对，
但我相当确定这种DNA
是被浴池中神秘物质改造过的。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
After much thought,
I concluded that this DNA probably belongs to
the unidentified creature that attacked me.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
经过深思熟虑，
我得出结论，这种DNA很可能属于
袭击过我的那个不明生物。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'd better compare the two.
Please return to the bath
and look for the creature's {0}.
If you can, please bring me 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我最好将两者进行比对。
请回到浴池，
寻找那个不明生物的{0}。
如果可以的话，请给我带10个回来。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Haven't you found the unidentified creature's {0} yet?
Look carefully!
I'm certain that the creature
dropped his {1} somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你还没找到不明生物的{0}吗？
仔细找找！
我确信那个生物
把它的{1}掉落在某处了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You've collected all the {0} samples, finally.
As humans say,
I've been waiting forever for them.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你终于收集齐了所有的{0}样本。
用人类的话说，
我等它们等得花儿都谢了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I know that you've done a lot...
but you are carrying too many things.
Even though I want to give you pocket money, I can't.
Could you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我知道你做了很多事...
但你携带的东西太多了。
虽然我想给你零花钱，但我给不了。
你能减轻负重再回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
OK, I'll get to work right away.
If you have any business to attend to, do so.
The DNA analysis takes about 6 hours.
Why don't you go for a walk
and come back then?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
好的，我马上开始工作。
如果你有其他事要办，就去办吧。
DNA分析大约需要6小时。
你去散散步，到时候再回来吧？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm still analyzing the DNA.
The DNA analysis takes about 6 hours.
Why don't you go for a walk and come back then?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我还在分析DNA。
DNA分析大约需要6小时。
你去散散步，到时候再回来吧？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
This is not it.
The samples that you collected belonged to a normal species.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
不是这个。
你收集的样本属于普通物种。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Must be because so many species of creatures
have been in the bath.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
一定是因为太多不同种类的生物
都去过浴池。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm sorry, but please re-collect the samples.
This time, the {0}... Yes.
Please bring the {1} samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
很抱歉，请重新采集样本。
这次，是{0}...是的。
请带{1}样本回来。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Great! These samples are surely
from the mysterious creature.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
太好了！这些样本肯定
来自那个神秘生物。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
According to the analysis,
The DNA is a mutant form of fish DNA.
I'm not sure how long this creature
has lived in the bath,
but this DNA is 70% evolved
from the original fish DNA.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
根据分析结果，
这种DNA是鱼类DNA的变异形式。
我不确定这个生物
在浴池里生活了多久，
但这种DNA已经比原始鱼类DNA
进化了70%。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Where did this fish come from?
How can it survive in the warm bath water?
After the DNA analysis,
my head is filled with even more questions.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
这条鱼是从哪里来的？
它怎么能在这种温热的浴池水中生存？
DNA分析结束后，
我脑子里充满了更多的问题。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The village elders say
that the bath water comes from
the puddles around the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
村庄的长老们说，
浴池的水来自
村庄周围的积水坑。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If you get me a sample from the puddle
to the east, at 2 o'clock from here,
I'll tell you what to do next.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
如果你能给我带一份
东边，从这里看过去2点钟方向的积水坑样本，
我会告诉你接下来该怎么做。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You probably don't need to run around
like you did collecting
the bath water samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你大概不需要像采集
浴池水样本那样到处跑。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If you get all 4 puddle samples at once
it may be more convenient. However,
there's the risk of samples being damaged or mixed up.
Therefore, I'm going to send you one place at a time. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
如果你一次性收集齐4份积水坑样本，
可能会更方便。但是，
样本有损坏或混淆的风险。
因此，我会让你一次去一个地方。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Go to the puddle to the east of the village,
and collect a sample.
It's going to be at 2 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你还没去采集积水坑样本吗？
去村庄东边的积水坑，
采集一份样本。
它位于从这里看过去的2点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You have the sample from the puddle to the east?
Great job, but it's no time to rest -
the research is almost done.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你拿到了东边积水坑的样本？
干得好，但现在还不是休息的时候——
研究即将完成。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Get me a sample from the puddle from the west.
It's not completely to the west...
The puddle should be at 7 o'clock
from the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
给我一份西边积水坑的样本。
不是正西方向...
积水坑应该在
村庄的7点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Take care not to damage the sample.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
小心别弄坏样本。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Go to the puddle to the west of the village,
and collect a sample.
It's going to be at 7 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你还没去采集积水坑样本吗？
去村庄西边的积水坑，
采集一份样本。
它位于从这里看过去的7点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You have the sample from the puddle to the west?
Great job, but it's no time to rest -
the research is almost done.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你拿到了西边积水坑的样本？
干得好，但现在还不是休息的时候——
研究即将完成。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Get me a sample from the puddle from the south.
The puddle to the south
should be... at 6 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
给我一份南边积水坑的样本。
南边的积水坑
应该在...这里的6点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I can't emphasize this enough, even if I did it 1000000000000000000000 times.
Please take care that
the sample is not damaged.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
无论我说多少遍，我都无法强调得足够。
请确保
样本没有损坏。

scripts.text:
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Get me a sample from the puddle from the south.
The puddle to the south is located
at 6 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
你还没去采集积水坑样本吗？
给我一份南边积水坑的样本。
南边的积水坑位于
这里的6点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You know what I'm going to say?
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你知道我要说什么吗？
小心。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You have the sample from the puddle to the south?
Now only the puddle to the north
remains to be sampled.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你拿到了南边积水坑的样本？
现在只剩下北边的积水坑
需要采样了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Please get me the sample from the puddle to the north.
It's not completely to the north.
it's at 11 o'clock from the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
请给我北边积水坑的样本。
不是正北方向。
它在村庄的11点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You know what I'm going to say?
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你知道我要说什么吗？
小心。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Please get me a sample from the puddle to the north.
It's not exactly north of the village.
The puddle should be located at 11 o'clock
from the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你还没去采集积水坑样本吗？
请给我北边积水坑的样本。
它不在村庄的正北方向。
积水坑应该位于
村庄的11点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You brought the last sample from the puddle from the north.
Great work. You've done really well.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你带来了北边积水坑的最后一份样本。
干得漂亮。你做得非常好。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Now, I'm going to do some research
with these samples,
looking at the relationship between
these puddles and the bath.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
现在，我要用这些样本
做一些研究，
看看这些积水坑
和浴池之间的关系。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I know that you've done a lot...
but you are carrying too many things.
Even though I want to give you pocket money, I can't.
Could you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我知道你做了很多事...
但你携带的东西太多了。
虽然我想给你零花钱，但我给不了。
你能减轻负重再回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If I finish this experiment...
There's probably nothing else to do. While I run the experiment,
why don't you go and entertain yourself?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
如果我完成这个实验...
大概就没有其他事情要做了。在我运行实验期间，
你不妨去娱乐一下？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Comparison of the samples and the bath water
will take about 12 hours.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
样本和浴池水的对比
大约需要12小时。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
What? You're here? Well...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
什么？你在这里？好吧...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
But the sample studies have not been finished.
This is an experiment for the final result,
so don't be too hasty.
I think the research will take about 12 hours.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
但是样本研究还没有完成。
这是为了最终结果的实验，
所以不要太着急。
我认为研究大约需要12小时。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Come back then.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
那就回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're here? Finally,
the experiment results are all in.
Do you want to look at the results?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你来了？终于，
实验结果都出来了。
你想看看结果吗？

scripts.text: Actually, I don't want to.
scripts.translation: 其实，我不想看。

scripts.text: Look at the results.
scripts.translation: 看看结果。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Good thinking. Actually, it may hurt
regular people's brains to look at it.
I suppose it's time for your reward
for helping me out so much.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
想得很周到。其实，
看这个可能会伤害普通人的大脑。
我想是时候给你奖励了，
毕竟你帮了我这么多。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Did I talk to you about the reward before the experiment?
That you won't be sorry that you helped out...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我在实验前跟你说过奖励的事吗？
说你帮忙后不会后悔...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're curious about the results? Really???
OK, here it is.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你对结果很好奇？真的？？？
好吧，给你看。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
There are no volcanoes around the area
and no record of volcanoes in the past,
but the water temperature is that high...
Isn't it surprising?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
这一带没有火山，
过去也没有火山的记录，
但水温却这么高...
是不是很惊讶？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The ingredients are... yes.
There are certainly substances that are beneficial for you humans.
But, there are also substances
that are fatal to us Raffles,
or other races.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
成分嘛...是的。
确实有一些对你们人类有益的物质。
但也有些物质
对我们拉弗尔斯，
或其他种族是致命的。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
And if you look at the electric conductivity,
it is quite higher than that of the average water.
My theory is that
this must be the cause of the mysterious power.
That's what I'm thinking about.
Anyhow.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
而且看电导率，
比普通水高得多。
我的理论是，
这一定是神秘力量的原因。
我是这么想的。
总之。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
There is something at work that science cannot explain
in the bath water...
Take the unidentified creature, for instance.
How strange is it that a fish can live
in such warm water?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
浴池的水里
有科学无法解释的东西在起作用...
比如那个不明生物。
鱼能在这么热的水里生存，
是不是很奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm not satisfied with the research results and conclusions.
I guess in the end,
it will remain a mystery...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我对研究结果和结论并不满意。
我想最终，
它仍会是一个谜...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I suppose it's time for your reward
for helping me out so much.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我想是时候给你奖励了，
毕竟你帮了我这么多。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Did I talk to you about the reward before the experiment?
That you won't be sorry that you helped out...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我在实验前跟你说过奖励的事吗？
说你帮忙后不会后悔...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I was thinking about what you would want
for your reward... and I felt
a little... sad.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我在想你会想要什么作为奖励...
然后我感到
有点...难过。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
... ... ... ...

[Raffle Researcher]
During our short time here together working on these projects,
I sent you all over the place.
It must've been hard, but you didn't complain at all.
And unlike some of the other guys I've had,
you never skipped work.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
在我们一起工作的这段时间里，
我派你到处跑。
一定很辛苦，但你从未抱怨。
而且不像我遇到的其他人，
你从未缺勤。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I suppose I've grown fond of you,
so that it saddens me to say goodbye...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我想我已经对你产生了感情，
所以要说再见让我很难过...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
But thank you anyhow. I've been researching for a while,
but I've never met such an excellent research assistant as you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
但无论如何，谢谢你。我研究了一段时间，
但从未遇到过像你这样优秀的研究助手。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Hmm? By the way...
You are carrying too much weight.
Could it be because you are also sad
about parting ways?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
嗯？顺便问一下...
你携带的东西太多了。
难道是因为
你也为分别感到难过吗？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
With this weight, I can't give you a reward!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
带着这么重的东西，我没法给你奖励！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The best research assistant in my life...
is you, {0}!!!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我这一生中遇到的
最优秀的研究助手...
就是你，{0}！！！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If we happen to run into each other again,
let's work on a research project once more.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
如果我们再次相遇，
希望能再一起进行研究工作。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Hmm? No?... What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
嗯？没有吗？...那你来这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Could it be that you suddenly want to look at
the research report???
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
难道你是突然想看看
研究报告？？？

scripts.text: Look at the report.
scripts.translation: 看看报告

scripts.text: I came to say hello.

当你试图逃跑时，不明生物发现了你并发动了攻击。

^FFFF00You cannot use the mysterious power of the bath water.^000000

You arrived at the puddle to the {0}.
You should look for the unidentified creature's family.
scripts.translation:
你到达了位于{0}的水洼。
你应该寻找不明生物的家族。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fish~ Fish~

When you called out, an answer came
from the puddle.
scripts.translation: 当你呼唤时，水洼中传来了回应。

scripts.text:
[???]
Who? Fisher? Go!
I'm looking for a particular fish's family.
scripts.translation: 我在寻找特定鱼的家族

scripts.text:
[???]
Family? What be that fish name?
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
家族？那是什么鱼的名字？

scripts.text: What was the name of the unidentified creature?
scripts.translation: 不明生物的名字是什么？

scripts.text:
[???]
No Family. {0} No.
You go.

[？？？]
没有家族。{0} 没有。
你走吧。

scripts.text: It appears that the unidentified creature's family is not here.

scripts.text:
[???]
{0}? Oh... How...
Husband here come. Your son.
News here.
scripts.translation:
[？？？]
{0}？哦...怎么...丈夫在这里。你的儿子。消息在这里。

scripts.text: Another creature from the puddle spoke to you.
scripts.translation: 水坑里的另一个生物对你说话了。

scripts.text:
[????]
What? Missing son news?
scripts.translation:
[？？？？]
什么？儿子失踪的消息？

scripts.text:
The two fish were very excited,
and their conversation was hard to follow.
You waited for them to calm down
and told them the full story.
scripts.translation:
两条鱼非常兴奋，
它们的对话很难听懂。
你等它们平静下来，
然后告诉它们完整的故事。

scripts.text:
[Fishee's Dad]
Yes... At night, son
gone... Night fishers.
Son stupid. Caught. Dead. OK.
scripts.translation:
[小鱼的爸爸]
是的...晚上，儿子
不见了...晚上钓鱼的人。
儿子笨。被抓了。死了。好的。

scripts.text:
[Fishee's Mom]
Fishee alive. Great. Great.
scripts.translation:
[小鱼的妈妈]
小鱼还活着。太好了。太好了。

scripts.text:
[Fishee's Dad]
Yes... Human give son news.
Thanks. Son,
We okay. Happy. Here. You tell son.
scripts.translation:
[小鱼的爸爸]
是的...人类给儿子带了消息。
谢谢。儿子，
我们没事。很高兴。在这里。你告诉儿子。

scripts.text:

Yes... Human give son news.

我们没事。很高兴。在这里。你告诉儿子。

你大声喊叫寻找鱼，
但没有回应。
我想这里没有人住。
在这个水坑里。

scripts.text: You see a puddle with a calm surface.
scripts.translation: 你看到一个表面平静的水坑。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的重量太重了，无法进行该操作。请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Hmm, you don't look reliable enough to perform tasks for me.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
嗯，你看起来还不够可靠，无法为我执行任务。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Why don't you come back when you've grown stronger? I can't give you tasks when you're in your current state.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
等你变强一点再回来吧。以你现在的状态，我不能给你任务。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
I have no additional tasks available now. If I get some, I'll let you know when you come back.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
我现在没有额外的任务。如果有的话，你下次来的时候我会告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Will you please check with ^990099Hotcha^000000
on the details of the previous task?
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
请去和^990099霍查^000000确认一下之前任务的细节。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Welcome.
I have some tasks for you - will you take a look at them?
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
欢迎。
我有一些任务给你——你要看看吗？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
scripts.translation: 你有什么任务给我？

scripts.text: Tell me about today's task.
scripts.translation: 告诉我今天的任务。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
I'm the Head of the Volunteer Patrol of the Village of Mora. It didn't used to be like this, he he.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
我是穆拉村庄志愿巡逻队的队长。以前可不是这样的，呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Each day, I'll be giving you a quest to kill off monsters in the surrounding area.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
每天，我都会给你一个任务，去消灭周围区域的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
You might get a task that's far too difficult for you to take care of alone - in that case, try to get help from your fellow adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
你可能会接到一个对你来说太难独自完成的任务——在这种情况下，试着向其他冒险者寻求帮助。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Let me see what tasks we've got today... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
让我看看今天有什么任务...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
How about this one?
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
这个怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Strange insects that carry fruit on their backs roam this area - you must've seen them.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
这片区域有奇怪的昆虫，背上驮着水果四处游荡——你应该见过它们。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
I'd like you to take them out as you see them, before they try to sell anything to the adventurers lost in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
我希望你见到它们就消灭掉，免得它们向在森林里迷路的冒险者兜售东西。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
There have been a lot of reports lately about mantises disguised as flowers attacking creatures passing by.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
最近有很多报告称，伪装成花朵的螳螂正在袭击路过的生物。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
No casualties have been reported yet, but it wouldn't hurt to take precautions. Please deal with them appropriately.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
目前还没有伤亡报告，但防患于未然总是好的。请妥善处理它们。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
An adventurer was reported to have been attacked by little birds while gathering resources in the vicinity of Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
有报告称，一名冒险者在双层牛肉堡附近采集资源时，被一群小鸟袭击了。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
They didn't look so ferocious... but the adventurer has asked me to get rid of them, so you'll have to do it.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
它们看起来并不凶恶...但那位冒险者要求我除掉它们，所以你得去办。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
I have qualms about this one, but somebody anonymously asked me to hunt down the naughty fairies.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
这件事让我有些犹豫，但有人匿名要求我捉拿那些调皮的仙女。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
I don't know what grudge he has against the fairies, but a request is a request.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
我不知道他为什么对仙女有意见，但要求就是要求。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Would you believe it if I said there are balls of blonde hair rolling around? You wouldn't, would you?
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
如果我告诉你有金色的毛球在到处滚，你会相信吗？你不会信，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
They don't seem so dangerous, but they are reported to steal books and sweets from adventurers. Please deal with them appropriately.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
它们看起来并不危险，但据报告称它们会偷冒险者的书和糖果。请妥善处理它们。

scripts.text: You have received the task ^005500{0}^000000. Open and see the quest window for the details.
scripts.translation: 你已接到任务 ^005500{0}^000000。请打开任务窗口查看详情。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品种类太多了，无法进行该操作。请丢弃一些物品后再试。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的重量太重了，无法进行该操作。请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Hmm, you don't look reliable enough for Elephantine's tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
嗯，你看起来不够可靠，不适合接象牙的任务。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
This place is like a paradise for adventurers. Not for weak ones like you, though.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
这里对冒险者来说就像天堂。不过，对你这种弱者来说就不一样了。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
I see you haven't received
any tasks yet.
Go talk to Elephantine,
and Elephantine will give you
one of the countless tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
看来你还没接到任何任务。
去找象牙谈谈，
象牙会给你无数任务中的一个。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
The time is up to complete the existing tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
完成现有任务的时间到了。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
If you have any unfinished tasks in your quest log, they are considered 'failed' and removed from the log.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
如果你任务日志中有未完成的任务，它们将被视为“失败”并从日志中移除。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Once they are removed, go talk to Elephantine and you can receive new tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
移除后，去找象牙谈谈，你就可以接新任务了。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Welcome.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
欢迎光临。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I have completed a task.
scripts.translation: 我已完成任务。

scripts.text:
Oh.
Have you?
Please wait a minute while I check the documents.
scripts.translation:
哦。
是吗？
请稍等，我查一下文件。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Yes, I see you've completed the task. It has been confirmed as completed.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
是的，我看到你已完成任务。已确认任务完成。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Hmm... {0}.
It may be a documentation error, but according to the documents, you have nothing to do with the tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
嗯... {0}。
这可能是文件记录有误，但根据文件显示，你并没有参与任何任务。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品种类太多了，无法进行该操作。请丢弃一些物品后再试。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的重量太重了，无法进行该操作。请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
I try to give tasks only to reliable people. You are......... no, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我只会把任务交给可靠的人。你嘛...算了，不说了。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
You really have no clue. What could you do with such a weak body?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
你完全不懂。就你那弱小的身体，能做什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
I have no additional tasks available now. If I get some, I'll let you know when you come back.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我现在没有额外的任务。如果有的话，等你回来时我会通知你。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Will you please check with the ^990099General Goods Dealer^000000
on the details of the previous task?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
请向^990099杂货商^000000确认一下之前任务的细节。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Welcome.
I have some tasks for you - will you take a look at them?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
欢迎光临。
我有一些任务给你——要看看吗？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
scripts.translation: 你有什么任务给我？

scripts.text: Tell me about today's task.
scripts.translation: 告诉我今天的任务。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Here, we make all kinds of supplies for adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
在这里，我们为冒险者制作各种补给品。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
We accept raw materials for the supplies once a day.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我们每天接收一次用于制作补给品的原材料。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Sometimes, we might ask for materials that are very difficult to obtain. In that case, try to get help from your fellow adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
有时候，我们可能会要求非常难以获得的材料。在这种情况下，请尝试向其他冒险者寻求帮助。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Let me see... what supplies are we making today...?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
让我看看...今天我们要制作什么补给品...？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
How about this one?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
这个怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The adventurers here make sure to bring with them, on their exploration to dungeons, a preservative to keep their food fresh. Do you know what the preservative is made from?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
这里的冒险者在探索地下城时，通常会随身携带一种防腐剂来保持食物新鲜。你知道这种防腐剂是用什么做的吗？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
*grin* None other than... Insect Feelers! The General Goods Dealer there asked me to get four of them. I personally would not eat it for all the world...
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
*咧嘴笑* 不是别的，正是...昆虫触角！那边的杂货商让我去弄四个。我个人就算给再多钱也不会吃这个...

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
These days, it's common for adventurers here to make talismans to protect themselves on their dangerous adventures. Like a kind of insurance.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
最近，这里的冒险者通常会制作护身符来保护自己在危险冒险中的安全。就像一种保险一样。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Immortal Hearts seem to be all the rage lately. The General Goods Merchant asked me to get five of them.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
不死心脏最近似乎很流行。杂货商让我去弄五个。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
They need tons of Rotten Bandages for making first aid bandages. They must have run out of new materials.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
他们需要大量的腐烂绷带来制作急救绷带。他们一定用完了新材料。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The client is the General Goods Merchant over there. Three bunches of them will be enough.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
客户是那边的杂货商。三束就足够了。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Symbols of strong warriors give adventurers great support on their journeys. That's why Orcish Vouchers sell like hotcakes.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
强大战士的象征能给冒险者在旅途中提供巨大的支持。这就是为什么兽人战士之证如此畅销。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Orcish Vouchers, which are to be used to make symbols of courage.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
杂货商让我去弄三个兽人战士之证，用来制作勇气的象征。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
It seems to be rumored among adventurers that drinking powdered bones mixed with water helps boost their stamina.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
听说冒险者之间流传着一种说法：将骨头磨成粉泡水喝，有助于提升体力。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Skel-Bones, which are to be used to make tonic.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
杂货商让我去弄三根骷髅骨，用来制作补品。

scripts.text: You have received the task ^880088{0}^000000. Open and see the quest window for the details.
scripts.translation: 您已接取任务 ^880088{0}^000000。请打开任务窗口查看详情。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的重量太重了，无法进行该操作。请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
Hmm, you don't look reliable enough for Bow-wow's tasks.
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
嗯，你看起来不够可靠，不适合接汪汪的任务。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
What could you do with that fragile body? Go get some exercise.
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
你那副弱不禁风的样子能做什么？去锻炼锻炼吧。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
I see you haven't received
any tasks yet.
Go talk to Bow-wow,
and Bow-wow will give you
one of the countless tasks.
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
看来你还没接取任何任务。
去找汪汪谈谈吧，
他会从无数任务中给你分配一个。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
The time is up to complete the existing tasks.
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
完成现有任务的时间到了。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
If you have any unfinished tasks in your quest log, they are considered 'failed' and removed from the log.
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
如果你任务日志中有未完成的任务，它们将被视为“失败”并从日志中移除。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
Once they are removed, go talk to Bow-wow and you can receive new tasks.
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
移除后，去找汪汪谈谈，你就可以接取新任务了。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
Welcome.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
欢迎光临。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I have completed a task.
scripts.translation: 我已完成任务。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
Oh.
Have you?
Please wait a minute while I check the documents.
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
哦。
是吗？
请稍等，我查一下文件。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
Hmm... {0}.
It may be a documentation error, but according to the documents, you have nothing to do with the tasks.
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
嗯... {0}。
可能是文件记录有误，但根据记录，你与这些任务无关。

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
The amount is not enough...
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
数量不够...

scripts.text:
[General Goods Dealer]
I've received the items all right. It will be some time before I have another task for you, so why don't you visit the hot spring and relax?
scripts.translation:
[杂货商]
物品已收到。接下来要过段时间才有新任务给你，不如去温泉放松一下？

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品种类太多了，无法进行该操作。请丢弃一些物品后再试。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的重量太重了，无法进行该操作。请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Can you please keep away from me? You're getting in the way.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
请离我远点？你挡路了。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
This place is not a nursery. Grow up and come back, and I'll gladly give you tasks.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
这里不是托儿所。长大点再来，我会乐意给你任务的。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
I have no additional tasks available now. If I get some, I'll let you know when you come back.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
我现在没有额外的任务。如果有的话，等你回来时我会通知你。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Will you please check with the ^990099Commodities Dealer^000000, standing across from me,
on the details of the previous task?
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
请去对面站着的^990099日用品商人^000000那里，确认一下上一个任务的详情。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Nice to see you.
I have some tasks for you - will you take a look at them?
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
很高兴见到你。
我有一些任务给你——你要看看吗？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
scripts.translation: 你有什么任务给我？

scripts.text: Tell me about today's task.
scripts.translation: 告诉我今天的任务。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Bow-wow and I are in the same industry.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
汪汪和我属于同一个行业。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
We are a manufacturer of adventurers' supplies.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
我们是冒险者用品的制造商。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
My tasks won't be easy - you'd better prepare yourself.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
我的任务可不容易——你最好做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Hmm... What tasks are at hand today?
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
嗯... 今天手头有什么任务呢？

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Oh. This one looks good.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
哦。这个看起来不错。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Some people just hang their talismans around their necks, but more people choose to seal them in special cases and carry them on their bodies.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
有些人只是把护身符挂在脖子上，但更多人选择把它们封存在特殊的盒子里，随身携带。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Mementos serve as inspirations for designers of those cases. The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two of them.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
纪念品可以作为这些盒子设计师的灵感。对面的日用品商人让我去拿两个。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Adventurers make sure to keep their talismans safe, because they could save their lives.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
冒险者会确保护身符的安全，因为它们可能会救命。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me seems to make protective cases out of Shells. I was asked to get three of them.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
对面的日用品商人似乎用贝壳制作保护盒。我被要求去拿三个。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Adventurers that go into the bushes of the Maze of the Hazy Forest always wear knee protectors.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
进入迷雾森林迷宫灌木丛的冒险者总是佩戴护膝。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get three Scale Shells, which are to be used to make knee protectors.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
对面的日用品商人让我去拿三个鳞片皮肤，用来制作护膝。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
I have a task for you at hand, making a vaccine for possible poisonous insects.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
我手头有一个任务，为可能的有毒昆虫制作疫苗。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two Venom Canines, which are to be used in the research of the substance.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
对面的日用品商人让我去拿两个毒牙，用于研究该物质。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
It seems they have run out of the material for adding non-slip soles to shoes.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
看来给长靴添加防滑鞋底的材料用完了。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me commissioned me to get five globs of Sticky Mucus.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
对面的日用品商人委托我去拿五团粘稠液体。

scripts.text: You have received the task ^880088{0}^000000. Open and see the quest window for the details.
scripts.translation: 您已接取任务 ^880088{0}^000000。请打开任务窗口查看详情。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
