scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Well, Woof-grrr can't have given a weakling like you tasks.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
哼，呜汪不可能给你这种弱者分配任务。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Go away! I can't concentrate on cataloging with you hanging around like that...
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
走开！你这样在旁边晃悠，我没法专心整理目录...

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
I see you haven't received
any tasks yet.
Go talk to Woof-grrr,
and Woof-grrr will give you
one of the countless tasks.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
看来你还没接到任何任务。
去和呜汪谈谈，
他会给你分配无数任务中的一个。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
The time is up to complete the existing tasks.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
完成现有任务的时间到了。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
If you have any unfinished tasks in your quest log, they are considered 'failed' and removed from the log.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
如果你的任务日志中有未完成的任務，它们将被视为“失败”并从日志中移除。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Once they are removed, go talk to Woof-grrr and you can receive new tasks.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
移除后，去找呜汪谈谈，你就能接取新任务了。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Welcome.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
欢迎光临。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: I have completed a task.
scripts.translation: 我已完成任务。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Oh.
Have you?
Please wait a minute while I check the documents.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
哦。
是吗？
请稍等，我查一下文件。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
Hmm... {0}.
It may be a documentation error, but according to the documents, you have nothing to do with the tasks.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
嗯... {0}。
可能是文件记录有误，但根据记录，您并没有参与这些任务。

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
The amount is not enough...
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
数量不足...

scripts.text:
[Commodities Dealer]
I've received the items all right. I look forward to working with you again.
scripts.translation:
[日用品商人]
物品已收到。期待与您再次合作。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的物品种类太多了，无法进行该操作。请丢弃一些物品后再试。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 你携带的重量太重了，无法进行该操作。请减轻负重后再试。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
Reliability is the primary quality needed in looking for lost souls. You don't look so reliable to me.
scripts.translation:
[灵魂向导]
寻找迷失的灵魂，首要品质是可靠。在我看来，你似乎并不够可靠。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
You need to have a strong spirit to do this task. I think you need a lot more discipline.
scripts.translation:
[灵魂向导]
执行这项任务需要强大的精神力。我觉得你需要更多的自律。

scripts.text: You still have marks of the haunting souls on your body.
scripts.translation: 你身上还残留着游荡灵魂的印记。

scripts.text: You'll have to come back when the marks have disappeared.
scripts.translation: 等印记消失后，你再回来吧。

scripts.text: You feel your mind has calmed down once again. You now have enough energy to go look for other souls, so talk to the Guide again.
scripts.translation: 你感到心境再次平静下来。现在你有足够的精力去寻找其他灵魂了，请再次与向导交谈。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
Welcome.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[灵魂向导]
欢迎光临。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
scripts.translation: 你有什么任务给我？

scripts.text: Tell me about today's task.
scripts.translation: 告诉我今天的任务。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
My job is to gather the remains of the souls haunting the forest and put them to rest.
scripts.translation:
[灵魂向导]
我的工作是收集在森林中游荡的灵魂残骸，并让它们安息。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
There are countless souls trapped in the Maze.
scripts.translation:
[灵魂向导]
迷宫中困着无数灵魂。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
Help them get their long-deserved rest.
scripts.translation:
[灵魂向导]
帮助它们获得久违的安息。

scripts.text:
[Soul Guide]
I'll show you the details of one of the lost souls.
scripts.translation:
[灵魂向导]
我会向你展示其中一个迷失灵魂的详细情况。

scripts.text: ^660066Age 32. Comes from Midgard. Has been missing for 3 months since he went to the Maze of the Hazy Forest in order to collect the native plants. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年龄32岁。来自米德加尔特。3个月前进入迷雾森林迷宫采集原生植物后失踪。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 19. Adventurer who came from a far, unknown place by ship. Been missing for 2 months since he went to explore the Maze dressed in thin tights, despite dissuasion of all Mora residents.
Even if he's alive, he would cause trouble to the rescue team.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年龄19岁。来自遥远未知之地的冒险者，乘船而来。2个月前不顾穆拉居民的劝阻，身穿紧身衣进入迷宫探索后失踪。
即使他还活着，也会给救援队带来麻烦。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age unknown. Has some mental illness. Went alone in order to purify the Maze of the Hazy forest. He insists that he has good ancestry but no one trusts him.
Disappearance period : 12 years. Not much chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年龄不详。患有某种精神疾病。独自进入迷雾森林迷宫，声称要净化迷宫。他坚称自己出身名门，但没人相信他。
失踪时间：12年。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 51. Used to be a big thief who stole famous swords from all around the world.
Went missing in the Maze after being pursued for running an illegal casino house which caused massive casualties in his final years. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年龄51岁。曾是著名的大盗贼，从世界各地偷窃名剑。
晚年因经营非法赌场导致重大伤亡而被追捕，随后在迷宫中失踪。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 22. An apprentice of an airship pilot. He has gone missing while drinking in Mora town, where he went for a break.
Rumor has it that he fled after signing somewhere. Disappearance period : 4 months. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年龄22岁。飞空艇飞行员的学徒。为了休假前往穆拉镇，却在饮酒时失踪。
传闻他在某处签了字后逃跑了。失踪时间：4个月。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age Unknown. A female with long hair, dressed in black. Went on an expedition to the forest of the Maze in search of eternal life. Disappearance period : 3 months. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年龄不详。长发女性，身穿黑衣。为了寻找永生而进入迷雾森林迷宫探险。失踪时间：3个月。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age around 50. The current Mayor of the Mora village. He ran away to the Forest of Maze after being caught pocketing profits by cheating the residents. Survival uncertain.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年龄约50岁。现任穆拉村村长。因被揭发通过欺骗村民中饱私囊而逃往迷雾森林迷宫。生死不明。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 29. A young man with an unknown background.
Fled to the forest of maze after scamming 1200 Mora coins from Mora residents while pretending to start a lot of business and adapting himself in Mora. Survival uncertain.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年龄29岁。背景不明的年轻男子。
在穆拉定居并假装创业，骗取了村民1200枚穆拉村硬币后逃往迷雾森林迷宫。生死不明。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age 34. Flirted with several women in Mora. Fled from Mora villagers to the forest of maze. Survival uncertain.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年龄34岁。在穆拉与多名女性调情。被穆拉村民追赶后逃往迷雾森林迷宫。生死不明。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age Unknown. Disappered with coins which were joint controlled by the villagers. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年龄不详。带着由村民共同管理的硬币失踪。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text: ^990099Information on missing person {0}^000000 has been found. Check your Quest Window for further information.
scripts.translation: ^990099已找到失踪者{0}^000000的信息。请查看任务窗口以获取详细信息。

scripts.text:
[Wandering Customer]
I don't know whether to believe this art dealer... He made me stand here like this for days.... Ah... I feel dizzy.
scripts.translation:
[闲逛的顾客]
我不知道该不该相信这个艺术品商人...他让我在这里站了好几天...啊...我觉得头晕。

scripts.text:
[Naive Customer]
I don't know when carving my pendant will be completed. Since he is a reliable art dealer, I suppose he won't break my pendant.
scripts.translation:
[天真的顾客]
我不知道我的吊坠什么时候能雕刻完成。既然他是位可靠的艺术品商人，我想他不会弄坏我的吊坠。

scripts.text:
[Victim]
You Bastard! I want my rugged outwear! That was passed on to me by my father *SOB*
scripts.translation:
[受害者]
你这个混蛋！把我的粗呢外套还给我！那是我父亲传给我的 *抽泣*

scripts.text: ^990099 It seems that he has gotten a great deal of damage from the art dealer.^000000
scripts.translation: ^990099 看来他被那个艺术品商人坑得很惨。^000000

嘿嘿

14.1 正在初始化所有任务窗口，包括相关日常任务、地图等

scripts.text: You have to make space in your inventory.
scripts.translation: 你需要在物品栏中腾出空间。

scripts.text: These must be [{0}]'s Remains. So carefully gather his remains.
scripts.translation: 这一定是[{0}]的遗骸。请小心地收集他的遗骸。

scripts.text: You picked up {0} Mora Coins next to the remains.
scripts.translation: 你在遗骸旁边捡到了{0}枚穆拉村硬币。

scripts.text: You see traces of recent digging.
scripts.translation: 你看到了最近挖掘的痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Chief]
We are the legendary order of the Neighborhood Knights, founded just five minutes ago!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团长]
我们是传奇的邻里骑士团，就在五分钟前成立的！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Chief]
We have four chiefs but no foot soldiers...
It's so frustrating!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团长]
我们有四位首领，却没有一个士兵...
真是令人沮丧！

scripts.text:
[Other Leaders]
Those other guys are all soldiers, but I'm the Boss!
I, the Head, will tell you what to do!
The Leader is the highest in the rank!
You talked me into joining the order, and now look at this!
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
那些家伙都是士兵，但我才是老板！
我，作为头目，会告诉你们该怎么做！
首领是等级最高的！
是你劝我加入骑士团的，现在看看这是什么样子！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
We've run out of Mora Coins.
Come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
我们的穆拉村硬币已经用完了。
明天再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
You have a lot of things with you!
Why not dump some of them in my pocket?
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
你身上带的东西真多啊！
不如把一些放进我的口袋里？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
So you've brought back
200 ^FF0000Mysterious Seeds^000000.
Are you working under my command?
I'm so confused
because I've been sending random people on errands.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
看来你带回了200 ^FF0000神奇种子^000000。
你是在我的指挥下工作的吗？
我有点糊涂了，
因为我一直在派随机的人去跑腿。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
I'll reward you as I promised.
You made sure everyone knows
it's the Order of the Neighborhood Knights's work, right?
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
我会兑现承诺奖励你的。
你肯定让大家都知道
这是邻里骑士团的功劳，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
You have courage to
show up out of nowhere
and demand Mora Coins... how impressive!
You're more than qualified to be a soldier of the Order of the Neighborhood Knights.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
你竟然敢凭空出现
索要穆拉村硬币...真是令人印象深刻！
你完全有资格成为邻里骑士团的士兵。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
Soldier, I need you to do something for me.
Go to the Hazy Forest and gather 200 ^FF0000Mysterious Seeds^000000!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
士兵，我需要你帮我做件事。
去迷雾森林收集200 ^FF0000神奇种子^000000！

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，长官！

scripts.text: I challenge you to a duel!
scripts.translation: 我要向你发起决斗！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
Good attitude, {0} Soldier!
I'll reward you handsomely when you get back.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
态度不错，{0}士兵！
等你回来我会好好奖励你的。

scripts.text:
[Other Bosses]
This is from me, the Chief!
Don't look down on the Head!
It's from me, the Leader!
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
这是我，首领的命令！
别看不起头目！
这是我，首领的决定！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
See the Chief if you want to have a duel!
I'm in charge of recruiting here.
Ahem...
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
想决斗的话去找首领！
我负责这里的招募工作。
咳咳...

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
You have a lot of things with you!
Why not dump some of them in my pocket?
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
你身上带的东西真多啊！
不如把一些放进我的口袋里？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
I hear that a Laphine called 'Lope'
went missing in the Hazy Forest.
I wish the Order of the Neighborhood Knights
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
我听说一只名叫“洛佩”的拉芬
在迷雾森林失踪了。
我希望邻里骑士团

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
could help solve the case,
but we can't now
because we're not done cleaning the yard yet.
So, what I'm trying to say is
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
能帮忙破案，
但现在不行，
因为我们还没打扫完院子。
所以，我想说的是

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
why don't you go
and deal with the problem
on behalf of the Order of the Neighborhood Knights!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
你为什么不替邻里骑士团
去处理这个问题呢！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
I promise, as the Head of the Order,
that I'll give you more work
when you get back!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
我作为团长向你保证，
等你回来我会给你更多工作！

scripts.text:
[Other Heads]
I approve it, as the Chief.
You can thank me, the Boss.
You know the Leader is the boss here, right?
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
我，首领，批准了。
你可以感谢我，老板。
你知道首领才是这里的老板，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
So the missing Laphine
is dead?
I'm sorry to hear that.
I could have saved him.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
所以那只失踪的拉芬
死了吗？
听到这个消息我很遗憾。
我本可以救他的。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
I hear that there are more ^0000FFLope's Clues^000000
in the Hazy Forest.
Go look for the rest of them
and bring back about 30 of them.
They will make great souvenirs.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
我听说迷雾森林里还有更多 ^0000FF洛佩之线索^000000。
去找找剩下的，
带回来大约30个。
它们会成为很好的纪念品。

scripts.text: Am I doing all the work here or what?
scripts.translation: 难道只有我在干活吗？

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，长官！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
So you've noticed it?
Darn! I should have given you work earlier!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
原来你注意到了？
该死！我早该给你派活了！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
It was worthwhile to have trained you after all.
I'm proud of you,{0} Soldier!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
看来训练你是值得的。
我很为你感到骄傲，{0}士兵！

scripts.text:
[Other Heads]
I think you'll make a great right-hand man, the Chief.
I feel rewarded, as the Boss.
As the Leader, I'm so pleased to see you all improve.
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
我觉得你会成为首领的得力助手。
作为老板，我感到很欣慰。
作为领袖，看到你们进步我真的很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
You still haven't gathered
^0000FFLope's Clues^000000?
I feel somewhat good,
because that's about what I expected out of you.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
你还没收集到 ^0000FF洛佩之线索^000000 吗？
我有点放心，
因为这就是我对你的预期。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
So you've brought back ^0000FFLope's Clues^000000.
Let's see ...
Assemble, assemble
Attach, attach
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
所以你带回了 ^0000FF洛佩之线索^000000。
让我看看...
组装，组装
连接，连接

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
...a traveler... attacked...
...under disguise... deadly poison...
...the Village... in danger...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
...一个旅行者...袭击了...
...戴着假面...致命猛毒...
...村庄...陷入危险...

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
What on earth does this mean?
Well done, anyway.
Cheer up, you will be a great head of the Knights like myself, someday.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
这到底是什么意思？
不管怎样，干得好。
振作起来，总有一天你会像我一样成为伟大的骑士团团长。

scripts.text:
[Other Heads]
I'm not so sure!
It's too much for us.
It's no use trying to do it.
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
我不这么认为！
这对我们来说太难了。
尝试也是徒劳的。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
We're in trouble.
We're sick of being knights.
We're thinking of forming
a circus troupe instead.
Are you interested in trying tightrope walking?
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
我们遇到麻烦了。
我们受够了当骑士。
我们在考虑改组马戏团。
你有兴趣试试走钢丝吗？

scripts.text: Well, I could do a fire show.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我可以表演火舞。

scripts.text: This is so absurd.
scripts.translation: 这太荒谬了。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
No, it's impossible.
I burned down a few houses
playing with fire.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
不，那是不可能的。
我玩火的时候烧掉了几栋房子。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
That's the answer I expected.
I'm proud of myself.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
这就是我想听到的答案。
我真为自己感到骄傲。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Leader]
I'm the Leader of the Order -
you can tell me.
What brings you here? Do you have some work for us?
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
我是骑士团的领袖——
你可以告诉我。
什么事把你带到这里？你有工作要交给我们吗？

scripts.text:
[Other Leaders]
Huh! I said the Boss is the boss!
No, the Chief is the best!
How rude you all are! I'm the Head here!
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
哼！我说老板就是老板！
不，首领才是最好的！
你们真没礼貌！这里我是团长！
